newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ONGC to build paraxylene unit.
newsitem.headline: India's ONGC to build paraxylene unit.

text.p: India's state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) is building a paraxylene plant in Hazira on the western coast, its chairman was quoted as according to a newspaper report.
"We are setting up a paraxylene plant in Hazira, we are also thinking of joining hands with a refining company in a venture," ONGC chairman Bikash Bora told the Business Line newspaper.
ONGC produces 90 percent of India's oil and natural gas. Paraxylene is made from naphtha and is the starting raw material for the manufacture of polyester.
"We are also thinking of diversifying into some downstream activities like value addition from the natural gas liquids that we produce," Bora said.

The company is also thinking of producing power from natural gas, Bora said. Unlike most other oil firms, ONGC owned drilling rigs and sismic groups and was planning to offer their services as independent business groups.
"Apart from producing oil and gas, we should also be able to generate a lot of revenue from service activities," he said.
